meta.title: Vendor fills a date column "Delivery by": pick a date in the past
gaps: The catalog has no dedicated assertion that identifies and reports both possible outcomes of submitting a past date as a single pass condition; the generic toast check can record an error or success, but cannot assert the product's refusal policy without assuming the expected outcome.

steps.note: Open an existing event suitable for the RFQ vendor-bidding flow while retaining the buyer session.
Move to Vendor A's supplier portal without replacing the buyer session.
Open the event's live RFQ pricing sheet in the vendor portal.
Choose a date that is unambiguously in the past.
Record the exact date displayed by the vendor portal before submission.
Submit the vendor quote after entering the past delivery date.
Record whether submission produces a success or refusal response.
Return to the buyer's console to inspect the submitted response.
Open the buyer's RFQ Responses view where the vendor's submitted values are shown.
Assert that the buyer view shows the same delivery date the vendor picked.
